Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
The Tern SCS System is MR Unsafe.
The device presents a projectile hazard. Do not bring it into the MR scanner room.
Patients with this device must not undergo MRI at 1.5 T or 3 T.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
